steps.title: Inspect Application Base Code
steps.description: Review the existing Modern Calculator components to verify layout structures and state tracking variables.

steps.title: Create Custom History Overlay Resource
steps.description: Design a modal layout with premium dark styling (dialog_history.xml) featuring scroll capabilities to review calculation runs.

steps.title: Create Missing Android Manifest File
steps.description: Generate a standard compatible AndroidManifest.xml specifying default light material styling and appropriate MainActivity configuration.

steps.title: Update Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Incorporate Root Layout ID inside activity_main.xml to allow dynamic background rendering.

steps.title: Define premium 4-Color Gradient Palette
steps.description: Choose 4 elegant dark-themed colors programmatically and initialize them using GradientDrawable.

steps.title: Integrate Tone Synthesis Controls
steps.description: Embed ToneGenerator support within the activity layer to produce responsive tactile audio tick responses during input actions.

steps.title: Establish Persistent SharedPreferences Registry
steps.description: Implement persistent shared records tracking system in order to log equations and sustain configurations even after reboots.

steps.title: Map Calculator Header Listeners
steps.description: Configure event listeners for the sound switch button and historical logging overlay triggers inside the app.

steps.title: Refine Equation Aggregator Engine
steps.description: Modify basic arithmetic computation outputs to save full mathematical strings directly into structured log registry.

steps.title: Validate Compatibility and Logic Flows
steps.description: Check resources integrity and confirm complete compliance under the default Android SDK target tools environment.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Perform the final gradle compile procedures to export functional deliverables equipped with new history logs, 4-color gradient backdrop, and interactive sounds.
